@everyone

 "Ready to Rise" 0.3.2 “ Release  

We are thrilled to announce this Release is now LIVE!

Nvidia AI Performance:


DLSS, Frame Gen, Ray Reconstruction, and Reflex added for supporting Nvidia GPUs. Can be accessed through the settings menu.
,

Hotzone: Speed Runner


Taking the idea of a walking simulator and turning it into a running and navigating competition! This mini-game is designed to prepare Cornucopians for quick Rift response. Get to a platform, choose your side, wait until the timer counts down, get to the next location as fast as you can. The current state is an early look, not fully featured yet.
,

Interaction Indicators:


Around the world you will now find loot boxes, nexus terminals, store terminals, automatic credit machines, and other actionable objects marked clearly for ease of player attention, with UI icons and colors to match.
,

SK-47 Battle Rifle:


Get your hands on an iconic battle rifle from the pre-calamity era, refurbished by Old World Provisions.
,

Core Dynamics Jetpacks: 


AlienX. - its sleek, mysterious, excels at quick recharge, but not ideal for quick ascent.
,
GlideSport. It has wings, also a good low flyer, very slow climb speed but forward flying will take you far.
,

New Shoes: 


Comet M42's added in all rarities, available at Nexus Express stations.
,

Quick Travel Access:


Solace 1, 2, and 3 can be easily accessed from the main menu for now.
,

Day/Night Cycle:


Days have been shortened from 8 hrs, to 4 hrs of real life time per game day.
,

Land Grab Is HERE!
,
The time you all have so patiently waited for has arrived. Our team is thrilled to announce that our Land Grab event (claiming phase NOT selection phase) will begin on Thursday, September 18 at 16:00UTC! There is a lot to digest, but we promise it’s simple to understand and you’ll be claiming in no time. 

We will release the entire article on how the land grab works tomorrow. But for now, the need to know information is this… 

Phase 1 (5 days): Stake your Claim - Not to be confused with the selection process below
Begins Thursday, September 18 16:00 UTC
During this phase, you will place claims on land plots for each of your land claim deed NFTs. This is NOT a FCFS (First Come First Served) claim!

IMPORTANT: You can continue placing claims on land plots that have not been processed yet throughout the duration of the live event.

Phase 2 (~ 5.5 days): Live Selection Event - This is when plots are assigned
Begins Wednesday, September 24 @ 16:00 UTC
The live event will last roughly 5.5 days. During the Live event, claims will begin to process starting with the Small Plots first, and ending with Copias Plots on the last day.


Here is a video tutorial on the process so you can begin familiarizing yourself with the interface:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-LV1Cp4NjWc

 Phase 3 Sale is LIVE! 
,
The marketplace is fully stocked with new exclusives, powerful returns from the Vault, and a final wave of classics that will never be offered again. 
From first of their kind collectibles to retiring icons, this is one of the most diverse sales to date.

 New Marketplace Feature: Baskets
Load up multiple items in one transaction and check out once. Faster, smoother, and ready for whatever you are hunting.

 Comet M42 Shoes Full Rarity Set
The FIRST EVER custom sneaker in Cornucopias with its own rarity run. These high performance kicks boost speed and jump, with buffs unlocking in upcoming releases. A must have for collectors, racers, and explorers.

 Corn Cuties White Snow
A snow furred fox companion with blush accents and the signature satchel. Calm, charming, and winter ready, this backpack buddy adds personality to every adventure.

 Superverse Komaru Defense Tiger M9 S Uncommon through Mythic
Precision built with a 50 round drum, optical scope, and silencer. Designed for those who demand control, stealth, and stopping power.

 FREE Common Komaru Defense Superverse Tiger M9 S
Everyone gets one. A free entry into Superverse tech that grants gated game access.

 Juggernaut Return from the Vault
The Atmos Juggernaut thunders back into the marketplace. Towering, unstoppable, and iconic, its sheer size makes it one of the most formidable vehicles in Cornucopias.

 Final Run Items Retiring After This Sale
This is your last chance. Once they are gone, they will not return:

Valkyrie F9 R 2024
A sleek, high performance racer built for blistering speed and S Class showdowns. Lightweight, aerodynamic, and engineered for legends.

Corn Cuties Grizzly Brown Brawler
Tough and rugged with a warm, earthy coat, this bear companion brings a mix of grit and charm to your journey.

Randos Metalworks JunkerJet
Scrap turned sky beast. A jet cobbled together from raw parts and rawer attitude, perfect for daredevils who do not mind a little smoke and rattle.

Corn Cuties Grizzly Purple Fury
A vibrant, fierce bear companion with striking purple fur. Loud, bold, and impossible to ignore.

Burger Barn Deluxe 1
The first of the Deluxe line. A collectible food stall skin that is part nostalgia, part utility, perfect for those who want flavor with flair.

Kargo Outfitters Titan XL
The largest hauler in the lineup. Built for scale, durability, and endless storage, this machine is every traders dream.

Zero G Stratos
A jetpack engineered for vertical dominance. Smooth thrust, endless air, and designed for those who live above the clouds.

Quantum Jack
A Seasonal Exclusive that blends festive flair with futuristic style. Its distinctive pumpkin design is powered by glowing quantum energy, making it a headpiece that stands out in any crowd.
